title: Design system proposal for decisions 5–10 (play, capture, create, browse, store, accessibility)
summary: Decisions 5–10 were locked by the Owner on 2026-09-16 (AUTH #005) from the Coordinator's option sets, so this ticket no longer proposes them. It now produces the implementation-ready mockups for the locked play, capture, create-flow, browse, results/store, and accessibility screens and runs the contrast and colorblind verification on the three test scans, so gj-gameplay and gj-platform can build against pixels, not prose.

acceptance_tests.test: HTML or Figma mockups under design/proposals/mockups/ for the play HUD and controls (landscape and Duo stand mode), both capture-coaching modes, the create-flow waiting states, browse cards and sort tabs, results and store screens, and the consent and age-gate screens, each faithful to the locked DESIGN_SYSTEM §5–§10.

Each screen is rendered on the three test scans (bright room, dark room, cluttered tabletop) with measured contrast for every text and icon token (text ≥ 4.5:1, icons ≥ 3:1), using the derived muted-text tokens from DESIGN_SYSTEM §2/§12 where cream surfaces are involved.
A deuteranopia simulation is attached for every state color, and every glass surface shows its flat variant.
Touch targets annotated (≥ 44 pt; play controls ≥ 56); safe-zone insets shown on a notched device and on the Duo.
Copy on every screen follows the decision-2 voice and vocabulary (environment/journey/summit/route/vista; never level/map/goal/user).
